evidence.ACL: in favor of degeneration of grade 1 injury.
evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in anteriot and posterior horn of medial meniscus with extending into the surface and suspicious of tiny cystic like focus abutting anterior horn, in favor of meniscus tear
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Bucket handle tear of lateral meniscus
evidence.Medial OA: Small osteophytes and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage of right knee, reflecting osteoarthritis
evidence.Lateral OA: Osteoarthritis of right knee, more prominent at lateral compartment, with grade 3-4 chondromalacia.
evidence.PF OA: Suspicious of tiny cystic change or vessel over subchondral region of lateral patella.
evidence.Effusion: Joint effusion with hypertrophy of the synovium
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium and suprapatellar, lateral and medial plicae, indicative of synovitis.
